title: Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol (DHCP) servers used within SIPRNet infrastructure must be configured with a minimum lease duration time of 30 days.
check_content:
Review the configuration of SIPRNet DHCP servers to verify that the lease duration is set to a minimum of thirty days.

If the lease duration is less than thirty days, this is a finding.
fixtext: Configure any DHCP server used on the SIPRNet with a minimum lease duration of thirty days.
VulnDiscussion: In order to trace, audit, and investigate suspicious activity, DHCP servers within the SIPRNet infrastructure must have the minimum lease duration time configured to 30 or more days.
